Time, well spent
Explore
An Island Apart
Surrounded by the warm waters of the Riau Islands, Telunas Private Island is a restorative retreat 50 km from Singapore. Here, time moves differently, shaped by the rhythm of the sea, the warmth of community, and the stillness that only an island can provide.
Choose a family-friendly Overwater Villa for time above the sea, or an adults-only Ridge Villa for a couples retreat with a private plunge pool. You can also explore the included scheduled activities or plan your journey from Singapore .
Telunas Private Island is an escape into simple island comfort and authentic hospitality. Soak up the sun above the ocean waters of Indonesia and find yourself in a natural island setting with resort comforts. Our island resort offers 15 well-appointed Overwater Villas with spectacular wide-angle views of azure sea and the rugged terrain of Sugi Island, relaxation at the infinity pool and bar, massage treatments at our overwater spa or on your veranda, a variety of sea and land activities, and limited-choice blackboard menus presented by our executive chef.
Each spacious 90 m² Overwater Villa includes a sitting room, private balcony, king-size bed, and a children s loft (sleeps 2 to 3). Distinctive furnishings are made from upcycled wooden boats. Baby cot and extra mattress available.
Daily scheduled activities are included in your stay. Your host will share the week s schedule with you on arrival. From kayaking to social activities like the village tour and jungle waterfall hike, the choice is yours. Do everything on the day s schedule, or just relax by the pool with a cold beverage in hand. For more than 20 years, this has been Telunas.

Plan Your Stay
More about the private pool and what a stay in a Ridge Villa actually looks like.
Your Private Plunge Pool
+ Each of the five Ridge Villas has its own plunge pool. It is not shared with other guests, and it is not tucked out of the way: the pool sits right off your outdoor living area, on the ridge, looking out over the sea.
Breakfast is served there each morning, with the sea spread out below, before the day gets going. Evenings tend to end the same way, with the pool lit and the villa quiet. That is the shape of a stay in a Ridge Villa: two people, a private pool, and very little else asking for your attention.
Life in a Ridge Villa
+ The bedroom is air-conditioned and faces the sea, with a king bed. Next to it, an oversized en-suite garden bathroom has both an indoor and an outdoor shower. Outside, a spacious outdoor living area opens toward the pool, with ceiling fans overhead.
Locally roasted specialty coffee, tea and hot chocolate are complimentary in the villa, along with a hot and cold water dispenser. Bath amenities include after-tanning and massage oils, a small detail for two people planning to spend most of the day doing very little. The choice is yours: quiet days spent in your villa and private plunge pool, or a more adventurous day built around the many included activities, with the villa to come back to at the end of each day.
Reaching the villas takes a moderate level of fitness: the walk up to the ridge is about 5 to 10 minutes.
Book Your Stay
Before You Book
What is included, and the questions couples ask most before booking.
What s Included, and What Isn t
+ The rate shown above (from USD 329* ( IDR 5,875,000 ) per night for 2 adults ) covers the villa itself. Food and beverage is a required meal plan, billed separately and currently USD 68* ( IDR 1,215,000 ) per adult, per day . The transfer between Singapore and the island is also billed separately and confirmed at booking.
Scheduled island activities are included at no extra charge, from kayaking, paddleboarding and island hopping to village tours, pottery and jungle waterfall hikes. Ridge Villas guests also get complimentary access to the scheduled activities at Telunas Beach Resort. The only extra charges are massage treatments, the fishing boat adventure, and a handful of specialty dining experiences such as a candlelight dinner.
Questions
Is the plunge pool actually private? + Yes. Each of the five Ridge Villas has its own plunge pool. It is not shared with other guests, and breakfast is served right there each morning.
Can we bring family, or is Ridge Villas couples-only? + Ridge Villas are adults-only (18+), with a maximum of two guests per villa. The wider Private Island common areas, including the Grand Lodge and Poolside Bar, are shared with couples and families staying in the Overwater Villas . If you are travelling with family, the Overwater Villas are the better fit.
How much does a Ridge Villa cost, and is anything extra? + The Ridge Villas rate is currently USD 329* ( IDR 5,875,000 ) per night for 2 adults , which covers the villa itself. Food and beverage and the transfer from Singapore are billed separately and confirmed at booking; scheduled island activities are included.
How do we get to Ridge Villas from Singapore? + Approximately 2.5 hours via Batam. Take the ferry from Singapore to Sekupang, where the Telunas team meets you and guides you onto the onward ferry into the Riau Archipelago. See Plan your journey for the full breakdown.
Is Telunas in Batam? + Not quite. Telunas Private Island sits on Sugi Island in the Riau Archipelago, about 50 km south of Singapore. Batam is the gateway: you arrive at Sekupang ferry terminal, where the Telunas team meets you for the onward boat of about 60 minutes. So the Ridge Villas are near Batam rather than on it, which is exactly what keeps them quiet.
Arrival note A moderate level of fitness is required. Approximately a 5 to 10 minute walk up to the ridge.
Adults-only note Ridge Villas are adults-only accommodation. The wider Private Island common areas, including the Grand Lodge and Poolside Bar, are shared with couples and families staying in the Overwater Villas.

Getting Here | Telunas Private Island
Skip to main content
Our Properties
Telunas Private Island
Getting Here
Two Boat Rides From Singapore to Your Own Private Island
Your Journey to Telunas
01
Book Your Ferry
From Singapore, take the Sindo Ferry from Harbourfront Centre Ferry Terminal to Sekupang Ferry Terminal. Book the 10:00am Sindo Ferry departure - most guests arrive at Sekupang around 10:00-10:10am Batam time. We recommend Sindo Ferry for the 10am slot.
Approx. 60 min ferry ride from Singapore
02
Complete Your Arrival Card
Every traveler to Indonesia must submit an arrival card in the All Indonesia app before they land, and it can be done from 72 hours before your arrival date. Our step by step guide walks through all seven screens and shows exactly what to enter for a ferry arrival at Sekupang.
Do this before you travel, not at the terminal
03
Arrive at Sekupang, Batam
Our staff (wearing blue Telunas polo shirts) will be waiting for you at Sekupang. They will guide you from international arrivals to domestic departures, a short 5-minute walk plus about 20 minutes of domestic terminal transit, then travel with you on the onward ferry to Telunas.
04
Boat to Telunas
After the domestic terminal transit, the scenic boat ride from Sekupang to Telunas takes approximately 60 minutes through the Riau Archipelago.
Approx. 60 min boat ride from Sekupang
05
Arrive at Telunas - Lunch Awaits
Upon arrival at Telunas, lunch will be served. Check-in time is 2:00pm, giving you time to settle in and begin your island escape.
Return Journey
Current Return Ferry Times
Early Departure
Leave Telunas at 8:15am on local ferry to Sekupang.
Sekupang to Singapore ferry departs 11:20am.
Normal Departure
Leave Telunas at 1:15pm on local ferry to Sekupang.
Sekupang to Singapore ferry departs 3:20pm.
Other Origins
Traveling from Elsewhere?
From Jakarta
Fly to Batam, Hang Nadim Airport (BTH). Allow ample time to collect your luggage, then take a taxi to Sekupang Domestic Ferry Terminal - approximately 45 minutes and IDR 150,000. You should plan to arrive on a flight no later than 8:45am. Our staff will meet you at Sekupang.
From Batam
Your trip begins at the Sekupang Domestic Ferry Terminal. Our staff (wearing blue Telunas polo shirts) will guide you from international arrivals to domestic departures, a short 5-minute walk plus about 20 minutes of domestic terminal transit, then travel with you on the onward ferry to Telunas. Please arrive at Sekupang Ferry Terminal by no later than 10:30am.
Pre-Arrival Information
For passport requirements, visa details, and everything you need to prepare before your trip, check our detailed pre-arrival information guide.
Pre-Arrival Info Contact Us
